decisions.summary: Closing words Done / Superseded by / Withdrawn (case-insensitive prefix) in one tuple the tests import; Implemented is not a closing word; a task is a column-0 '- [ ]' / '- [x]' / '- [X]' line, an indented box belongs to its task; no tasks = FILED.
decisions.why: FR-002 (finished/superseded/withdrawn, stated once) and the spec's edge case that the tasks decide over an 'Implemented' status. Round 2 adds only the '- [X]' form, which widens what the counter reads; it narrows nothing.

decisions.summary: scripts/speckit-todo.py run by make speckit-todo; three headed groups, one line per feature with title, ticked/total, (no spec.md) flag, counts per state; ALL=1 adds closed features with reason; exit 0 always.
decisions.why: FR-001, FR-003, FR-009 and the no-spec.md edge case. ALL=1 is opt-in and leaves the default listing exactly what FR-001 asks. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: Status lines rewritten only with evidence in audit.md; mixed features keep open tasks open; unsettled ones stay open and are listed for the GM; tasks are not ticked.
decisions.why: FR-004 and the spec's Assumptions. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: Search every spec and request for gm-assistant subjects and gm-assistant-only paths, read each hit, record search and result in audit.md, delete any found.

One make claim per filed entry; spec.md with heading title, Status 'Filed - from future-work/<file>, "<heading>", date', Input naming this feature, entry text verbatim; separate named pieces become one feature each; done or ruled-out entries closed in audit.md with evidence.
decisions.why: FR-006 and the spec's Assumptions. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: An entry naming an earlier feature (the funerary-grounds entry, 'was feature 275, withdrawn') is filed under a NEW claimed number like every other, its spec naming 275 as its history; 275 is not reopened.
decisions.why: Round 1's NOT LEGITIMATE finding is fixed exactly as asked: FR-006 requires every entry to become one new feature with its own claimed number, and the amended D5 does that. Confirmed against specs/275-village-burial-ground/request.md, which records the GM's withdrawal and 'The number stays spent; nothing is built under it' - the plan now leaves that record alone. No exception remains.

decisions.summary: Re-aim every live future-work/ mention (41 files, 77 mentions, git grep -o over tracked files outside specs/, dev/*-log/, dev/review-ledger.md, hook fixtures and future-work/) at the feature its entry became; directory-as-a-place mentions become the D7 rule; history keeps its words; check-old-layout.py extended to fail a new live mention.
decisions.why: FR-007 and SC-004 say 'live'; FR-006 itself requires each filed spec to name the future-work file it came from, so specs/ cannot be swept. The scope is 'every live file', not the count, so the figure decides nothing; re-run 2026-10-08 at a3928cfd5 with the stated exclusions it reproduces 41 files / 77 mentions (43 / 79 at 4b6963f6b, the two added being this feature's own speckit-todo.py and its test). The old-layout check fails only when SC-004's requested state is absent - enforcement of the request.

decisions.summary: Root CLAUDE.md, dev/lessons.md and every doc saying 'add it to future-work' instead say: defer work by make claim + spec.md with Status Filed, find open work with make speckit-todo.
Conversion script kept in the spec directory; tests in tests/tooling/; baseline make done at cd33340f5, zero new failures.
decisions.why: Implementation placement and the constitution's regression rule; no scope change.
